Aero 1.2 turns Aero into an all-in-one workstation: workspaces with other projects' tools built in (mobile apps with a live preview, code checks, diagrams, images made on your GPU, code review, end-to-end tests, a debugger, finance skills, curated libraries), autonomy modes so loops and chats can run without asking you for every action, models bigger than your GPU, and a faster router.

## Install or update

Aero 1.0 and 1.1 offer this update at startup (**Update now**). New installs:

| System | File | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Windows** 10 / 11 (64-bit) | `Aero-windows.zip` | Extract it, double-click `Update-Aero.bat`, accept the admin prompt. `--dest D:\Aero` installs elsewhere. |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `Aero-macos.zip` | Unzip it, right-click `Install-Aero.command` → Open. |
| **Linux**, any distro | `install.sh` | `curl -fsSL https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/releases/latest/download/install.sh \| sh` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `aero_1.2.0_all.deb` | `sudo apt install ./aero_1.2.0_all.deb` |
| Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Alma, openSUSE | `aero-1.2.0-1.noarch.rpm` | `sudo dnf install ./aero-1.2.0-1.noarch.rpm` |
| Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS | `PKGBUILD` | `makepkg -si` |
| Any Linux, by hand | `Aero-linux.tar.gz` | `sh Aero/install.sh` |

Models, chats, memory, settings, keys, tunings, HAPO profiles, MCP servers, skills and mods carry over. New settings start at their defaults (autonomy: ask each time).

## What's new

- **Workspaces with other projects built in.** Ten workspaces beside the chat, each with its tools inside Aero: **Code** (uv, ruff, pyright, Node.js, Biome, TypeScript, Go and Rust installed into Aero's folder; lint, types and tests in one list of problems; "does Safari support this CSS?" from MDN's data), **Mobile apps** (Flutter with a live preview of your app inside Aero and hot reload; iOS apps from Windows through xtool in WSL), **Create** (images made on your GPU with Z-Image-Turbo, 1024 × 1024 in about 14 s on an RTX 5080, and it fits a 4 GB card), **Diagrams** (diagram-design's 44 diagram types; Mermaid, draw.io and Excalidraw import; SVG and PNG export), **Review & test** (open-code-review and e2e on your own model), **Debug & reverse** (RAD Debugger, rea), **Finance** (48 of Anthropic's financial-services skills plus spreadsheet and deck checks; drafts for professional review, never advice or trades), **Library** (awesome-python, awesome-selfhosted, the-book-of-secret-knowledge), **Memory+** (Hindsight memory banks) and **Big models**.
- **Ask for the work, the right workspace opens.** "Build me a mobile app for my bakery" opens Mobile apps with Flutter's tools; anything a workspace needs installs into Aero's own folder after you say yes, with its size shown first.
- **Autonomy for chats and forever-loops.** *Ask me each time*, *Collect them and keep working* (the agent finishes everything it can and gives you one list of actions to approve), or *Full auto*, where a small authority model on your CPU allows or denies each action with a reason. The authority model (Qwen3-4B) answered all 32 exam decisions right, including 14 traps (money, passwords, injected instructions, mass deletion).
- **Models bigger than your GPU.** Aero plans where every part of a GGUF goes for the VRAM you have and adds a small draft model of the same family: Llama-3.3-70B at Q6_K generated **4.85 tokens a second on a 16 GB card** (1.0 without the draft), and Gemma-3-27B at Q8_0 ran in **3.1 GB of VRAM** at 2.6 tokens a second. For full-precision checkpoints that fit nowhere else, **AirLLM** is built in (Qwen2.5-32B in bf16 in 1.9 GB of VRAM; slow by design).
- **A faster router.** Decisions take 1.6 s on the CPU instead of 2.8 s with the same accuracy, or about 0.4 s if you move the router to the GPU (Settings → Router → Runs on).
- **Safer local API.** Aero now refuses state-changing requests that don't come from its own window. Before, a web page open in your browser could send requests to Aero on 127.0.0.1.
- **Installer you can point anywhere.** `Update-Aero.bat --dest D:\Aero` and friends; CI now updates a real 1.0 and 1.1 install in place on every change.

Everything was installed and run on a Windows 11 PC with an RTX 5080: what passed, what was fixed on the way and what was not run are in [V1.2_TEST_MATRIX.md](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/docs/V1.2_TEST_MATRIX.md); measurements in [V1.2_PERFORMANCE_REPORT.md](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/docs/V1.2_PERFORMANCE_REPORT.md).

Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/CHANGELOG.md).
